msg: First and foremost you have to concentrate really hard. If your mind wanders for even just a split second then it is likely that you will get timed out. You need to avoid this at all costs. Have in your mind that the basket equals space bar. Every time you see the basket press space immediately.As for a tactic about which gnome to pick. To be honest I don't think there is a right or wrong. I tried based on hat size, colour etc. but in the end it seemed to me that it was in fact a random pattern. I might be wrong but if there was one i missed it. What you should do instead is select in a way that helps you maintain your attention. For example do 10 whilst counting on one side and then swap and do 10 on the other side. Or do a run of only doing the pointy hatted ones for a bit then swap to only flat hats. You can then do a run of say 20 which you alternate from one side to the other. Alternatively I suppose you could just do one side all the way through.It will get boring so bear that in mind. 200 is a lot of turns and like I said if you are not concentrating you will get zero. I only got zero a few times after selecting so ultimately any selection is better than none.Enjoy.
